scope: Bounded linear scalar export from the supplied nontrivial irreducible regular-imaginary spherical principal-series Hilbert fibre; nonlinear, unbounded and nontrivial-target observation maps are outside the theorem.

functional_classification.carrier: H_ps=L2(K/M) with the supplied nontrivial irreducible regular-imaginary unitary principal series pi_lambda
functional_classification.riesz_form: every bounded linear scalar export is O_eta(v)=<eta,v> for a unique eta in H_ps
functional_classification.trivial_target_intertwiner_condition: O_eta pi(g)=O_eta for all g iff pi(g)^* eta=eta for all g
functional_classification.invariant_vector_result: a nontrivial irreducible unitary representation has no nonzero invariant vector
functional_classification.chosen_export: every nonzero eta defines a bounded scalar export but selects eta and preserves at most its stabilizer
functional_classification.spacetime_compatibility: I_spacetime tensor O_eta commutes with scalar spacetime evolution while transforming eta under G

claim_ceiling: A nonzero bounded linear export from the regular principal-series fibre to a scalar cannot preserve the full internal Spin_0(7,7) action; it requires a chosen covector and reduces symmetry to its stabilizer. This does not exclude nonlinear, unbounded or nontrivial-target observation maps and does not select the GU observation map.
